convert_ernie4_5_tokenizer: run the convert_ernie4_5_tokenizer script to convert ERNIE-4.5 tokenizer from HuggingFace repo to local output directory
load_ernie4_5_tokenizer: load the LlamaTokenizer with ERNIE-4.5 special tokens and chat template from a HuggingFace repo
add_special_tokens: add custom mask tokens like <mask:4> through <mask:7> as special tokens to the tokenizer
convert_slow_to_fast_tokenizer: convert a slow LlamaTokenizer to a fast LlamaTokenizerFast tokenizer from pretrained files
push_tokenizer_to_hub: save and push the converted ERNIE-4.5 tokenizer to a HuggingFace Hub repository
